content:
Overview

Champaign is a city in IL with a population of 88,000. Home of the University of Illinois with a vibrant college town and research park. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.1.
